get.description: Requires the account bearer. Without author, lists the newest public publications. With author (alias, @alias or 64-hex public ID), lists that author's publications the caller may see: public ones, friends-only ones when the caller is the author's friend, and private ones only for the author; an unknown author has none. format keeps one document format. Newest updated first, at most 50. Each publication is {id, author {alias, public_id}, format, title, levels, visibility, updated_at, mine}. Limited to 120 reads a minute per account.

post.summary: Publish or replace a level collection
post.description: Requires the account bearer. document is an opaque JSON object of at most 262144 bytes; levels counts its top-level levels array. visibility is public, friends (the author's friends) or private (the author alone). Without id this creates a publication with a new id; with id it replaces the format, title, visibility and document of the caller's own publication, and anyone else's answers 404. An account keeps at most 100 publications, and documents count toward its storage. Publishing and unpublishing are limited to 60 an hour per account.

title.description: 1 to 80 bytes of UTF-8 without control characters

400.description: Invalid format, title, visibility or document

404.description: No publication of the caller's has this id

413.description: Document too large, 100 publications already, or the account storage limit reached (code storage_full)

get.summary: Fetch a publication and its document
get.description: Requires the account bearer. Returns {publication, document} when the caller may see it under its visibility; otherwise 404, so a publication's existence never leaks. Limited to 120 reads a minute per account.

200.description: Publication metadata and the stored document; no-store

404.description: Missing or not visible to the caller

delete.description: Requires the account bearer. Only the author may delete a publication; anyone else's and missing ids answer 404.

404.description: No publication of the caller's has this id
